entries.title: Artifact validation is a 2,255-line unchecked monolith

finding_snapshot.title: Artifact validation is a 2,255-line unchecked monolith
finding_snapshot.why_it_matters: The skill's trust gate must remain locally understandable as new halt and history rules are added.
finding_snapshot.what_is_wrong: validate-artifact.py owns JSON loading, registry retirement, history checks, provider attribution, checkpoint freshness, halt semantics, scorecard rules, and CLI output in one 2,255-line file, while the repository's module-size gate scans only quorum-review and peer-plan-review.
finding_snapshot.why_weakens_submission: The skill enforces structural rigor on targets while exempting its own most change-prone correctness module from the same guard, increasing cross-gate regression risk.
finding_snapshot.minimal_correction_path: Move existing pure checks unchanged into three private modules grouped by core schema, registry/history, and halt/runtime concerns; keep validate-artifact.py as the thin re-exporting CLI expected by selftests; add contest-refactor/scripts to the existing pre-commit module-size loop. Do not add classes, a plugin registry, or generated validators.

entries.title: Unused fixture files contract accepts paths outside the fixture

finding_snapshot.title: Unused fixture files contract accepts paths outside the fixture
finding_snapshot.why_it_matters: A deterministic fixture validator should not contain an unexercised path rule that can be satisfied by unrelated filesystem content.
finding_snapshot.what_is_wrong: The optional files array is absent from every fixture.toml, yet _validate_one_fixture joins each supplied value directly to fixture_dir and checks only exists(), so absolute paths and parent traversal are accepted as declared fixture files.
evidence: contest-refactor/evals/fixtures/*/fixture.toml: no files field in the current corpus
finding_snapshot.why_weakens_submission: Dead validation code both enlarges the parser and advertises a guarantee it does not safely enforce.
finding_snapshot.minimal_correction_path: Delete the optional files branch and its comment. Do not add path-normalization machinery until a real fixture needs this contract.

entries.title: Replication contract is copy-pasted across two baseline validators

finding_snapshot.title: Replication contract is copy-pasted across two baseline validators
finding_snapshot.why_it_matters: Measured evaluation evidence is only credible when its shared artifact rules have one implementation.
finding_snapshot.what_is_wrong: The advisory and principal baseline selftests independently implement the same replication-block fields, five-slot accounting, invalid-count check, floor ordering, and valid-result requirements; the clone detector reports 0.89 similarity across roughly 92 lines, while arm and contamination rules are the only material differences.
finding_snapshot.why_weakens_submission: The evaluation layer can disagree with itself about whether recorded measurements are valid, weakening the evidence used to judge the skill.
finding_snapshot.minimal_correction_path: Extract only the shared replication shape and terminal-attempt checks into one private helper used by both selftests; leave advisory arm selection and principal contamination/retry policies local.

entries.title: G32 accepts a terminal challenge that skipped mandatory arm diversity

finding_snapshot.title: G32 accepts a terminal challenge that skipped mandatory arm diversity
finding_snapshot.why_it_matters: The terminal trust gate can certify HALT_SUCCESS without any simplicity or domain-modeling attack.
finding_snapshot.what_is_wrong: halt-verifier.md requires a simplicity/domain_modeling challenge arm, but check_g32_halt_success_challenge validates only that attempts is non-empty; the positive held fixture uses only data_flow.
finding_snapshot.why_weakens_submission: A reachable terminal path can bypass a required dimension of independent scrutiny, leaving the success claim structurally under-validated.
finding_snapshot.minimal_correction_path: Extend G32 to validate attempt shape and require one new_finding attempt targeting simplicity or domain_modeling; add that arm to the valid fixture and a failing no-diversity fixture.
